stemMd:
What is the value of the positive real number x?

(1) $x^2=49$.

(2) $x<10$.

Which assessment of sufficiency is correct?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Statement (2) alone is sufficient, but statement (1) alone is not.

options.label: B
options.textMd: Even together the statements are not sufficient.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Statement (1) alone is sufficient, but statement (2) alone is not.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Together the statements are sufficient, but neither is sufficient alone.

explanationMd: Positivity plus the squared equation selects x=7, so the squared equation alone is sufficient. The upper bound permits many positive values. Combining it with the equation does not supply information needed to determine x.
